review_description: We chose CDC Solar and Electrical after getting 3 quotes through SolarQuotes for our Sunshine Coast area. At their site visit John explained everything clearly and went through the installation process and what happens when the system is up and running. Their quote was the lowest, but not by much. Installation was done efficiently in 8 hours with minor disruption to us.The components they used were mid range according to SolarQuotes and were adequate for the size of the system according to my research. So far their follow-up has been good.I have no hesitation in recommending them for solar system installation.

Very positive experience with CDC Solar from the quoting process all the way through to the installation.  I was kept informed at all times and had very useful discussions about system size and which components to install before agreeing on the final quote.I eventually went with 44 Jinko Solar Tiger Neo 510W panels (22.44kw) and SigEnergy 20kw inverter with 5x 8kwh battery packs (40.3kwh).  The guys arrived on time and the installation went very smoothly.  The system is working very well and I have switched over to Amber VPP.Overall a seamless and stress free process and I would fully recommend CDC solar.

John from CDC Solar was extremely helpful and explained the system I was after very well. I felt confident I was getting the right system for my property. Loving having a battery to reduce the bills even more. Installation went very smoothly and the team installing were polite and friendly. After installation, the app was explained to me and they cleaned up everything perfectly. I highly recommended this company.
Clancy and the team at CDC Electrical were very professional, prompt and offered great service and advice, i can not recommend them highly enough.

The quoting process was detailed, informative & competitive on price. On acceptance of the quote, an installation date was agreed within 2 to 3 weeks after acceptance.  Clancy & his team from CDC arrived on time and completed the installation in a very polite & professional manner. They made sure the work site was clean & tidy on completion of the install.CDC organised all the necessary grid connections and Clancy walked me through the system and the associated app in full before leaving.I would highly recommend Clancy & his team from CDC
Super easy process, great customer service and support, couldn't ask for a better experience.

Clancy and the team were fabulous to work with. From the initial quote (where he actually hopped up on the roof to confirm everything!), to the communication around our queries about the quote, availability of booking the installation, and the seamless installation on the day, we have absolutely no complaints! Clancy and his team were punctual, brought everything with them on the day, tidied up after themselves (even swept!), connected the inverter to wifi and got us up and running on the app with a demo of how it all works. The installation is so neat and tidy (and beautiful), and they even moved our aerial to ensure no panel shading. Highly recommend CDC!

CDC Solar & Electrical was a great company to deal with. Clancy took the time to run us through all the in's  and out's of Solar. Really happy with the installation and the follow up visit for how to fine tune our usage.
